code_examples.section: ltm rule event SIP RESPONSE SEND
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

SIP_RESPONSE_SEND
       Triggered immediately before a SIP response is sent.

DESCRIPTION
       Triggered immediately before a SIP response is sent.

Examples
	when SIP_RESPONSE_SEND {
	  log local0. [SIP::route_status]
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.4.2 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
